name: Gale Guard triggers its knockback on taken damage, up to 3 attacks (#5277)
contract: Gale Guard (500923) tooltip: 'enemies who damage you [are] struck with a gust of wind and knocked back... Lasts for $d or 3 attacks.' It carries a live SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) effect (EffectTriggerSpell 504872), but Spell.dbc gives it ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never proc'd: no knockback on any hit taken. Physical knockback motion is not assertable by this harness, so this proves the triggered cast instead (spell_proc_count, which the README defines as counting the casts an aura's own proc fired). The new spell_proc row (PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE, Charges 3, since Spell.dbc's own ProcCharges is 0/unlimited) makes it reachable and caps it at 3 attacks, matching the tooltip. Self-applied Corruption rank 8 (27216) supplies controlled 150-damage ticks every 3 sec as taken damage, the same fixture stormbringer-fix-stormcloak-family.json uses for the same PROC_FLAG_TAKEN_DAMAGE class.

steps.label: BASELINE: no proc has fired yet
Self Corruption rank 8: a 150 damage tick every 3 sec
DISCRIMINATING: the first taken hit procs the knockback (fails today: stays 0)
DISCRIMINATING: the second taken hit procs it again
DISCRIMINATING: the third taken hit is the last charge
DISCRIMINATING: Gale Guard falls off once its 3 charges are spent, matching 'or 3 attacks'
